senses.gloss: (I)--(लोकपृष्ठ): a kind of hell: persons fallen from वर्ण and आश्रमधर्म find this hell. Br. IV. 2. १५०, १७७-78; वा. १०१. १४९, १७९; Vi. II. 6. 4.

(II)--equated with अज्ञान or ignorance, bound by three fetters; to think that which is not eternal as eternal, to regard happiness in one's difficulties, to regard one's own [page२-010+ २७] self which is not his own, and to regard that as pure which is impure;
1: Br. IV. 3. ३३-38.
fourfold, with तामसि vr2tti, the lowest.
2: Ib. 3. ५३.
(III)--the eleventh kalpa. M. २९०. 5.

(I)--a son of Priyavrata, and a Manvantara adhipati.
1: भा. V. 1. २८; Vi. III. 1. २४.
The fourth Manu and brother of Uttama. He had पृथु and nine other sons. During this epoch the gods went by the name of Satyakas, Haris, etc. त्रिशिख was Indra. ज्योतिर्धामा and others were the seven sages.
2: भा. VIII. 1. २७-28.
Brother of Raivata.
3: Ib. VIII. 5. 2.
For different names of Gods, sages and Indra in this epoch;
4: Br. II. ३६. 3, ४२-50; M. 9. १५.
represents उकार;
5: वा. २६. ३६; ६२. 3.
twenty-seven गणस् of Gods mentioned in this epoch--सुपार, Haraya, etc. शिबि was Indra; Nara and ख्याति, his sons.
6: Vi. III. 1. 6, १६-19.
(II)--the quality of भूतादि swallowed by Mahat of which Buddhi is the गुण. वा. १०२. १९-20.
--a शक्ति on the षोडसपत्राब्जा. Br. IV. ३२. ११.
--a hell among the twenty-eight in number. Here are put to torments, those who lay hands on another's property, children and women. भा. III. ३०. २८; IV. 6. ४५; V. २६. 7-8; Vi. I. 6. ४१; III. ११. १०४.
--a son of असमञ्ज. M. ४४. ८३.
--the विमान with faces on all sides on which rode तिरस्कर्णिका. Br. IV. २४. ७५.
--a war-musical instrument; others are Bheri, मिस्साण, and पणवानक. Br. IV. २४. १४.
--a son of शार्न्गदेवा and Vasudeva. वा. ९६. १७७, २४९.
--a forest tribe of the Vindhyas. Br. II. ३६. १४५. [page२-011+ २४]
--one of Atri's wives. Br. III. 8. ७६. [page२-014+ ३३]
--four गणस्; each of २५ devas; sages; sons. वा. ६२. ३७-43.
--in this epoch were created sons of Himsa and of Adharma. वा. १०. ३८-45.
(II)--one of the three मात्रस् of Om, the प्रणव. वा. २०. 2.
(III)--a R. of the केतुमाला country. वा. ४४. १७. [page२-015+ ३७]

(IV)--(काला, प्रजाक्षयकरि);
1: वा. ६६. ८५, ८९. १००.
possessed by Bhava.
2: Ib. ६६. १०१-5.
(V)--also known as पूतना; wife of Sadrama. वा. ८४. १२.
--that which is at the bottom; four-fold; no belief in the Veda, शिष्ताचार, non-observance of वर्णाश्रम and of धर्म शास्त्रस्। वा. १०२. ५४, ७०-73.
--an attendant on the king. M. २१५. १५.
(I)--a son of Mura (s.v.). भा. X. ५९. १२.
(II)--a monkey chief. Br. III. 7. २३४. [page२-016+ ३०]
(III)--a son of सत्यभामा and कृष्ण. M. ४७. १७; Br. III. ७१. २४७.

(I)--one of कश्यप's wives. Her progeny were hawks, vultures, eagles, curlews, geese, शुकीस् and others;
1: भा. VI. 6. २६-27; M. 6. 2 and ३०; वा. ६९. ३२५-26. Vi. I. १५. १२५; २१. १४-17.
daughter of Pulaha;
2: Br. III. 3. ५६; 7. ४४५ to ४४८; ६९. ३२५.
mother of Apsarasas.
3: M. १४६. १८; १७१. २९ and ६०.
[page२-018+ ३२]
(II)--Wife of Vasudeva; her son was Sahadeva. M. ४६. १६.
(III)--a daughter of दक्ष and wife of कश्यप. वा. ६६. ५४.
--a son of कृष्ण and रोहिणी. भा. X. ६१. १८.
--a son of रोहिणि and कृष्ण. Vi. V. ३२. 2.
(I)--the elephant of the साम fold. Br. III. 7. ३३७.
(II)--one of the nine divisions of भारत- वर्ष. M. ११४. 8; Vi. II. 3. 6.

(I)--a R. of the कुलाचल hill in भारत- वर्ष,
1: भा. IV. २८. ३५; V. १९. १८.
and in द्राविड.
2: Ib. XI. 5. ३९.
Visited by बलराम;
3: Ib. X. ७९. १६.
from the Malaya Hills flowing through sandal wood regions; famous for pearls and conch; fit for श्राद्ध offerings;
4: Br. II. १६. ३६; III. १३. २४-7; IV. ३३. ५२; Vi. II. 3. १३.
sacred to पितृस्;
5: M. २२. ४९; ११४. ३०.
flows towards the southern ocean; at its confluence with the ocean are produced conches, shells and pearls.
6: वा. ७७. २४-5.
(II)--a daughter of सत्यभामा. Br. III. ७१. २४८; वा. ९६. २४०.
--(ताम्रम्) copper vessel for ceremo- nial purposes; fit for gifts. M. 7. १२; ५८. १३; ५९. 8; ६१. ४५; २०६. १५; २७९. 7; २८८. ११; वा. ७४. 1. [page२-017+ ३२]
--a daughter of रौद्राश्व. वा. ९९. १२६.

--the territory under King देवरक्षित;
1: Vi. IV. २४. ६४.
an eastern country and tribe; a Janapada of the east.
2: Br. II. १८. ५१; III. ७४. १९७; M. ११४. ४५; १२१. ५०; १६३. ७२; वा. ४५. १२३; ९९. ३८५.
--a son of सत्यभामा. वा. ९६. २३९.
--a Mt. near Patanga in the southern direction. वा. ३८. 8.
(I)--a division of the भारतवर्ष. Br. II. १६. 9; वा. ४५. ७९.
(II)--a R. of the Malaya hills. वा. ४५. १०५.
(III)--name of an elephant; son of पुष्प- danta. वा. ६९. २२१.
--copper hall; of Lalita's श्रीपुर--square in shape spreading to seven yojanas. There was कल्पकवा- टिक between this and काम्श्यशाल full of beautiful and fragrant trees. Br. IV. ३१. ६६.

--Mt. south of the मानस;
1: वा. ३६. २३.
the residence of काद्रवेय Taks2aka.
2: वा. ३९. ५४.
